title: The 3/2 counter of 1RB1RE_1LC1LB_1LE0LD_1LE1LC_0RF1RA_---1RA: 10<sup>7</sup> epochs, and it digs like a random 2-adic counter
text: A 2-adic epoch simulator, checked against the exact one, runs 10,000,000 epochs (more than 10<sup>3,521,825</sup> steps) without a halt. Lean proves that the counters following a parity word of length n are one residue class mod 2<sup>n</sup>, so random 2-adic counters are coin flips; the real run digs into the stack exactly as often as they do, with a geometric tail of 0.68 per run.
